+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Test to verify that the fix for empty params matching works correctly.
+This addresses the issue: https://github.com/lundberg/respx/issues/...
+
+The issue was that respx_mock.get("https://example.com", params__eq={}) 
+would match requests with ANY query params instead of matching only 
+requests with NO query params, because the empty dict {} was being skipped.
+"""
+
+import httpx
+import respx
+from respx.patterns import M, Params
+
+def test_empty_params_matching():
+    """Test that empty params dict matches only requests without query params."""
+    
+    print("=== Testing Empty Params Fix ===")
+    
+    # Test 1: Create pattern with empty dict using M function
+    print("\n1. Testing M(params__eq={})")
+    pattern = M(params__eq={})
+    assert pattern is not None, "Pattern should not be None"
+    print(f"   Created pattern: {pattern}")
+    
+    # Test 1a: Match request WITH NO query params
+    request_no_params = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com")
+    match_no_params = pattern.match(request_no_params)
+    assert bool(match_no_params) is True, "Should match request with no params"
+    print(f"   Match no params request: {bool(match_no_params)} ✓")
+    
+    # Test 1b: Match request WITH query params (should NOT match)
+    request_with_params = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com?key=value")
+    match_with_params = pattern.match(request_with_params)
+    assert bool(match_with_params) is False, "Should NOT match request with params"
+    print(f"   Match with params request: {bool(match_with_params)} ✓")
+    
+    # Test 2: Compare with non-empty params
+    print("\n2. Testing M(params__eq={'key': 'value'}) for comparison")
+    pattern_with_value = M(params__eq={"key": "value"})
+    assert pattern_with_value is not None, "Pattern should not be None"
+    print(f"   Created pattern: {pattern_with_value}")
+    
+    # Should match request with matching params
+    request_matching = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com?key=value")
+    match_matching = pattern_with_value.match(request_matching)
+    assert bool(match_matching) is True, "Should match request with matching params"
+    print(f"   Match matching params request: {bool(match_matching)} ✓")
+    
+    # Should NOT match request with different params
+    request_different = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com?other=thing")
+    match_different = pattern_with_value.match(request_different)
+    assert bool(match_different) is False, "Should NOT match request with different params"
+    print(f"   Match different params request: {bool(match_different)} ✓")
+    
+    # Should NOT match request with no params
+    match_no_params_2 = pattern_with_value.match(request_no_params)
+    assert bool(match_no_params_2) is False, "Should NOT match request with no params"
+    print(f"   Match no params request: {bool(match_no_params_2)} ✓")
+    
+    print("\n=== All tests passed! The fix works correctly. ===")
+
+
+def test_none_values_still_skipped():
+    """Test that None values are still properly skipped."""
+    
+    print("\n=== Testing None Value Skipping ===")
+    
+    # Test that None values are still skipped
+    pattern_none = M(params__eq=None)
+    assert pattern_none is None, "None values should still be skipped"
+    print("   M(params__eq=None) correctly returns None ✓")
+    
+    print("=== None value skipping works correctly. ===")
+
+
+def test_other_empty_containers():
+    """Test that other empty containers also work now."""
+    
+    print("\n=== Testing Other Empty Containers ===")
+    
+    # Empty list should also work
+    pattern_empty_list = M(params__eq=[])
+    assert pattern_empty_list is not None, "Empty list should create pattern"
+    print(f"   M(params__eq=[]) creates: {pattern_empty_list}")
+    
+    # Empty string should also work
+    pattern_empty_string = M(params__eq="")
+    assert pattern_empty_list is not None, "Empty string should create pattern"
+    print(f"   M(params__eq='') creates: {pattern_empty_string}")
+    
+    # Test that they behave the same as empty dict
+    request_no_params = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com")
+    request_with_params = httpx.Request("GET", "https://example.com?key=value")
+    
+    # All should match no params request
+    assert bool(pattern_empty_list.match(request_no_params)) is True
+    assert bool(pattern_empty_string.match(request_no_params)) is True
+    print("   All empty containers match no params request ✓")
+    
+    # All should NOT match params request
+    assert bool(pattern_empty_list.match(request_with_params)) is False
+    assert bool(pattern_empty_string.match(request_with_params)) is False
+    print("   All empty containers do NOT match params request ✓")
+    
+    print("=== Other empty containers work correctly. ===")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_empty_params_matching()
+    test_none_values_still_skipped()
+    test_other_empty_containers()
+    print("\n🎉 All tests passed! The fix is working correctly.")
